title: EvaLLM: Interactive Evaluation of Large Language Model Prompts on User-Defined Criteria
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. It introduces a system (EvaLLM) for evaluating LLM prompts based on user-defined, task-specific criteria. The examples and tasks used in the paper (e.g., explaining scientific concepts to children, ideating journalistic angles) are secular.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as this was not a focus of the research.
